title: Finite runs and transition reachability
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $c,c'$ be configurations of $M$ on the same input. There is a finite sequence of zero or more single steps, each made using some choice bit, from $c$ to $c'$ if and only if there is a finite Boolean word $w$ such that running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ yields $c'$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbol alphabet.
Two configurations $c,c'$ on the same input.
